title: P02 — 모노폴리를 만든 진짜 사람 (리지 매기 / US748626)

beats.ko: 이 게임을 만든 건, 우리가 아는 그 남자가 아니었죠.
beats.en: The man who made this game? Not who you think.
A jobless man in the Depression, they said.
That one game made him a millionaire.

beats.ko: 그런데 삼십일 년 먼저 나온 원본이 있었습니다.
beats.en: But an original came thirty-one years earlier.
Its maker was a woman: Lizzie Magie.

beats.ko: 감옥, 철도, 임대료, 한 바퀴 돌면 월급.
beats.en: Jail, railroads, rent, wages each lap.

beats.ko: 우리가 아는 규칙이 이미 다 있었죠.
beats.en: Every rule we know was already there.
A company bought her rights for five hundred dollars.

beats.ko: 서류에 적힌 이름은, 리지 제이 매기.
beats.en: The name on the document: Lizzie J. Magie.
That was all. No royalties, ever.
The truth surfaced in a 1973 courtroom.
She had died twenty-five years earlier.

beats.ko: 매기가 이 게임을 만든 이유는 돈이 아니었습니다.
beats.en: Magie did not build this game for money.
She built it to teach that monopoly ruins us.
